source: GPU memory of the last pipeline stage (TP1 x PP8, the stage with the output layer and the MTP head), measured on one A100-PCIe-40GB on 2026-10-28 before any 9B training step ran; the run log incidents 17 and 18, configs/sft/sft_9b.yaml.

before_fixes.fixed_state_note: BF16 weights + FP32 gradients + Adam sharded over DP3, 3.14B parameters
before_fixes.loss_note: main + MTP losses, both upcasting the full 248,320-word logits to FP32

after_fixes.fixed_state_note: Adam on the CPU (FP32 master weights there only), one decoder layer on the last stage: 2.49B parameters x 6 bytes
after_fixes.loss_note: Transformer Engine cross entropy on BF16 logits: 0.94 MiB per token plus the output layer's 2 GiB weight gradient, measured at 20,841 tokens

measured_peak_note: 8-node pre-flight on the 12 longest rows (2026-10-29), after fix 3; the GPU holds 40,437 MiB
